cand.title: World Physiotherapy Congress 2027
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Natasha Joyner, head of events and marketing, manages event planning/delivery logistics and is the strongest named organizer routing contact. Shlomi Ashkenazi is BookingMaster’s co-founder and CEO, making him a commercially relevant intermediary escalation candidate, not a verified 2027 contracting officer. Amelia Brunt, congress project manager, oversees scientific programme support and registration and is a secondary organizer referral route, not a demonstrated accommodation buyer. No source establishes any individual’s hotel-contract signing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition: 14–16 May 2027 in Guadalajara, Mexico, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not publication dates. World Physiotherapy’s future-congresses page and local host AMEFI agree. The accommodation widget instead displays 13–15 May 2027; retain 14–16 May as the organizer-confirmed congress dates and resolve the widget discrepancy before quoting stay dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: a 216-room, full-service Expo-adjacent city hotel fits congress delegates, speakers, exhibitors and small ancillary meetings better than a destination-resort proposition. The official hotel search is distance-based, making the stated Expo proximity commercially relevant. No room allocation, meeting request, hotel walking time, or resort preference is evidenced; do not budget all 216 rooms or calculate room nights from attendance.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the confirmed congress venue, not a hotel. This closes the principal congress-venue proposition, not necessarily hotel-room sales. No named official host hotel, contracted room block, or Sheraton allocation was verified in the retrieved accommodation material.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified biennial series since 2017: Geneva 2019; online 2021; Dubai 2023; Tokyo 2025; Guadalajara 2027. These are different destinations, not evidence of annual Guadalajara demand. Lisbon, Portugal, is already announced for 2029, outside this horizon. No next Guadalajara edition is established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN, neither verified open nor verified closed. BookingMaster is the sole official accommodation partner; hotels@bookingmaster.travel is the published accommodation contact and also its sales/partnerships address. Participant hotel contracts are with the booking agent, not World Physiotherapy. Group enquiries for more than five rooms are supported, but attendee booking access is not evidence of an open hotel procurement process. General partnership solicitation is not event-specific supplier acceptance.
findings.organizationStructure: World Physiotherapy is the international nonprofit association and UK-registered charity behind the congress; AMEFI Colegio Nacional de Fisioterapia/Mexican Association of Physiotherapy is the 2027 host member organization. Expo Guadalajara is the venue. BookingMaster is the official accommodation booking intermediary, not the event owner. Corvian Global’s published registration-enquiries address establishes a registration route only; it does not establish hotel procurement authority or a full-service PCO appointment.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Main congress space is already committed to Expo Guadalajara and official accommodation distribution is incumbent with BookingMaster. No named competing hotels, sold-out conditions, room shortfall, block pickup, or overflow requirement were verified. Treat overflow solely as a hypothesis to test, not a published opportunity.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach hotels@bookingmaster.travel with the supplied Expo-adjacent hotel profile and a nonbinding rate/availability proposal. Ask who manages Guadalajara contracting, whether the hotel is already listed, whether additional suppliers are accepted, current pickup/needs and permitted partnership terms. In parallel, address Natasha Joyner via congress@world.physio for the accommodation lead and any separately sourced organizer/speaker/ancillary requirements; use Amelia Brunt only for referral if needed. Request reconciliation of the widget’s 13–15 May display with official 14–16 May activity dates before proposing arrival/departure nights. If supply is closed, seek a documented waitlist or referral route; do not assume overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of the requested assessment date, the 2027 edition is future and registration is open. Delegate/group accommodation can be requested through BookingMaster; accessibility for a new hotel supplier is unconfirmed. Venue commitment does not prove that accommodation contracting is closed. Do not market the hotel as an official congress partner without approval.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize remaining 2027 accommodation distribution and association/delegation/exhibitor relationships, subject to supplier acceptance. Longer-term recurrence supports relationship development, not a recurring Guadalajara room forecast: the 2029 congress is already assigned to Lisbon. No future Guadalajara congress-venue capture is substantiated.
